classification.difficultyReason: Translate gestation timing into numerical bounds, standardise and use table complements and symmetry.

content.prompt: Human gestation is approximately normally distributed with mean 266 days and standard deviation 16 days. Give percentages to the nearest whole percent.

children.label: a
children.prompt: About $0.75\times365\approx274$ days is nine months. What percentage of females give birth before 274 days?

answer.worked:
Let $X$ be the gestation time in days.
$$\begin{align*}z&=\frac{274-266}{16}\\&=0.5\\P(X<274)&=P(Z<0.5)\\&\approx0.6915\end{align*}$$
Approximately $69\%$ give birth before 274 days.

children.label: b
children.prompt: If 266 days is “on time”, what percentage give birth more than:

answer.worked:
More than one week early means before day $266-7=259$.
$$\begin{align*}z&=\frac{259-266}{16}\\&=-0.4375\approx-0.44\\P(X<259)&=P(Z<-0.4375)\\&\approx P(Z<-0.44)\\&=1-P(Z\le0.44)\\&\approx1-0.6700\\&=0.3300\end{align*}$$
Approximately $33\%$ give birth more than one week early.

More than one week late means after day $266+7=273$.
$$\begin{align*}z&=\frac{273-266}{16}\\&=0.4375\approx0.44\\P(X>273)&=P(Z>0.4375)\\&\approx P(Z>0.44)\\&=1-P(Z\le0.44)\\&\approx1-0.6700\\&=0.3300\end{align*}$$
Approximately $33\%$ give birth more than one week late.
